limits: The fixed wait may still dominate; only this fictional service model is covered.

relation: Smaller batches can reduce waiting before approval and exposure to edition changes.

limits: A batch still requires four available items; final incomplete batches need explicit reporting and cannot be silently flushed.

relation: Earlier service can shorten citation age and queue residence.

relation: Grouping source-related work is a common scheduling alternative that may change rework and spillover.
